# Copilot Instructions

- Keep responses and edits concise.
- Limit changes to this repository unless asked otherwise.
- Reuse existing UI patterns and component style.
- Avoid broad redesigns unless explicitly requested.
- Keep TypeScript/JS changes minimal and readable.
- Run lightweight checks for touched areas (for example `npm run lint` or `npm run build`).
- Update docs only when user-visible behavior changes.
